# Nutgraf.studio

> Nutgraf is a data design studio. We turn client data into charts, graphics, reports, maps and interactive visualisations that audiences understand, remember and act on. We also run flagship workshops that teach teams data research, data design and data storytelling, built around state-of-the-art AI used well and safely.

Nutgraf works with newsrooms, NGOs, cultural institutions and public-sector clients including the BBC, the Financial Times, Médecins Sans Frontières, Afrobarometer and the Istituto Italiano di Cultura. Studio and workshops are available worldwide, on-site or remote.

## Pages

- [Studio](https://nutgraf.studio/): Services, methodology and selected work — data design, research and reports, mapping and visualisations.
- [Workshops](https://nutgraf.studio/workshops/): Flagship half-day-to-two-day workshops in data research, data design and data storytelling for teams, built around state-of-the-art AI. Includes format, pricing approach and frequently asked questions.
- [Exhibitions](https://nutgraf.studio/exhibitions/): Data exhibitions for cultural diplomacy, designed for embassies, cultural institutes and trade agencies. Features Între noi, an exhibition on Italy and Romania told with data, with its film and photos.
- [Reports](https://nutgraf.studio/reports/): Data visualisation reports, infographics and interactive dashboards: report design for flagship, annual and ESG reports, and PDF reports turned into dashboards. Features Afrobarometer's Beyond borders and Rețele Electrice România's 2024 sustainability report. Markdown version: https://nutgraf.studio/reports/index.html.md

## Data reports, data visualisation and dashboards

Nutgraf's flagship service. Full details: https://nutgraf.studio/reports/index.html.md

- Data report design: flagship, annual, research, sustainability and ESG reports designed around their data, with one chart system per report and every number checked against its source.
- Data visualisation (data visualization, dataviz) and infographics: bar charts, dot plots, heatmaps, Sankey diagrams, maps, KPI tiles and one-page country scorecards, for print and for screen.
- Interactive dashboards: PDF reports rebuilt on their datasets, for outward data-driven storytelling (funders, partners, the press, the public) and inward data-driven decision making (boards, management, programme teams).
- Case study: Afrobarometer's Beyond borders (African insights 2026): 48 pages, 38 figures and 4 tables, Round 10 survey data from 38 countries; the colophon reads "Report design by nutgraf.studio".
- Case study: Rețele Electrice România (PPC Group), Sustainability Report 2024: 105 pages in Romanian, the company's first prepared with reference to ESRS; its page 49 traces 793,348 tCO2e from three scopes to eleven sources and is rebuilt on the web page as an interactive Sankey diagram.
- To start: a brief, a dataset or last year's PDF; Nutgraf replies within a week with a page plan, a chart system and a timeline. Email hello@nutgraf.studio.
